NEW src/commands/auth.ts. Local `gwrk auth key` subcommands writing `0600` non-checkout secret files with `ADR-004` signals. Tests: src/adapters/auth/credential-crypto.test.ts

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/db/operations.test.ts — In the `preserves execution and Slack receipt data across both migration 018 files` test (lines 194-201), add `"020-production-auth.sql"` after `"019-outbox-metadata-uniqueness.sql"` in the `.toEqual([...])` array for `SELECT name FROM _migrations WHERE name >= '015' ORDER BY id`.
FIX: vitest.config.ts — Add `"tests/hosted-pilot/gate-completeness.test.mjs"` to the `test.exclude` array (lines 20-27) so Vitest does not collect the `node:test` script invoked directly by `node tests/hosted-pilot/gate-completeness.test.mjs` in `specs/051-hosted-aws-pilot/gates/phase-08.sh`.

REVIEW FAIL (uat): US-004 local private-host key administration CLI (gwrk auth key list text output) — Expected: `gwrk auth key list` in default text mode displays full untruncated public credential IDs (29-char default `cred_<24-hex>` IDs and up to 64-char public IDs) so operators can pass listed IDs directly to `gwrk auth key revoke <id>` and `gwrk auth key rotate <id>`. Actual: `src/commands/auth.ts:521` slices `cred.credentialId.slice(0, 28)`, truncating the final character of every default-generated credential ID (e.g., `cred_215d7127a5cfd3c4c8ed2e46` renders as `cred_215d7127a5cfd3c4c8ed2e4`), so passing the listed ID to `revoke` or `rotate` fails with exit 1 (`not found`). Behavioral regression patch: `.runs/review-regressions-phase-02-uat-list-id.patch`. See spec.md > US-004, FR-006. Fix: Restore `.runs/review-regressions-phase-02-uat-list-id.patch` first and observe RED on `pnpm vitest run src/commands/auth.test.ts`; remove `.slice(0, 28)` truncation on `cred.credentialId` in `src/commands/auth.ts` (size the Credential ID column dynamically to fit the longest ID without truncation); rebuild and pass `bash specs/051-hosted-aws-pilot/gates/phase-02.sh`.

MODIFY src/server/routes/health.ts. Filter hosted `GET /api/health` to one authorized project and serve minimal private `GET /health`

REVIEW FAIL (code): hosted-health-denial-request-id — FR-010.
  WHERE: src/server/routes/health.ts:377-383
  EXPECTED: Hosted GET /api/health JSON denials (HTTP 400/401/403/404) include `requestId: request.id` alongside `ok: false`, `code`, and `error` without credential values (per FR-010 and contracts/production-auth.md).
  ACTUAL: `reply.status(httpStatusForDenial(decision.code)).send({ ok: false, code: decision.code, error: decision.message })` omits `requestId`. Observed RED in `src/server/auth-api-keys.test.ts` lines 838 and 860 (`expected { ok: false, ...(2) } to match object { ok: false, requestId: Any<String> }`).
  FIX: Restore behavioral regression patch `.runs/review-regressions-phase-04-code-review.patch` first and observe RED; add `requestId: request.id` to the hosted `/api/health` denial payload in `src/server/routes/health.ts:378-382`; preserve all existing tests and pass `bash specs/051-hosted-aws-pilot/gates/phase-04.sh`.
  GATE: specs/051-hosted-aws-pilot/gates/phase-04.sh (coverage hole: passed while requestId was missing on hosted /api/health denials)
  REF: plan.md Phase 4 > src/server/routes/health.ts; spec.md > FR-010; contracts/production-auth.md > Route policy

MODIFY src/server/index.ts. Register auth pre-handler and CSRF plus auth routes and scoped health while keeping `trusted_local` separate

REVIEW FAIL (code): hosted-auth-guard-bypass-via-resolvePrincipal — FR-007, FR-010.
  WHERE: src/server/index.ts:664-738
  EXPECTED: Whenever `effectiveTransport === "hosted"`, `startServer` MUST unconditionally register `registerHostedAuthGuard` and default-deny `setNotFoundHandler`, wire `resolveVerifiedPrincipal` as the sole principal reader for all operational routes (`healthRoutes`, `statusRoutes`, `dispatchRoutes`, `notifyRoutes`) so a caller-supplied `options.resolvePrincipal` can NEVER bypass the guard or replace guard-established context, and unconditionally pass `transport: "hosted"` to `healthRoutes` so `/health` serves minimal private liveness and `/api/health` requires project authorization.
  ACTUAL: `const useHostedAuthGuard = effectiveTransport === "hosted" && (Boolean(options.hostedAuth) || !options.resolvePrincipal)` disables `registerHostedAuthGuard`, `setNotFoundHandler`, `resolveVerifiedPrincipal`, and hosted `healthRoutes` scoping whenever `options.resolvePrincipal` is supplied without `options.hostedAuth`. Observed RED in `src/server/auth-prehandler.test.ts:1269`: an unauthenticated `POST /api/dispatch` returned HTTP 201 (`AssertionError: expected [ 401, 503 ] to include 201`) and created an operation row, `GET /api/health` served unfiltered multi-project readiness without auth, and `GET /health` ran Git/provider probes and exposed project metadata.
  FIX: Restore behavioral regression patch `.runs/review-regressions-phase-04-code-review.patch` first and observe RED; set `useHostedAuthGuard = effectiveTransport === "hosted"` unconditionally in `src/server/index.ts:664-666` (never allowing `options.resolvePrincipal` to disable the hosted guard, hosted health scoping, or guard-established context); update obsolete pre-051 hosted `startServer` test mocks in `src/server/routes/dispatch.test.ts`, `src/server/two-repo-isolation.test.ts`, and `src/server/unattended-recovery.test.ts` to inject `hostedAuth` and authenticated scoped `/api/health?projectId=...` calls while preserving their behavioral assertions; rebuild and verify `bash specs/051-hosted-aws-pilot/gates/phase-04.sh` plus those updated server test files pass.
  GATE: specs/051-hosted-aws-pilot/gates/phase-04.sh (coverage hole: passed while caller-supplied resolvePrincipal bypassed hosted guard and hosted health)
  REF: plan.md Phase 4 > src/server/index.ts; phase4-composition-plan.md; spec.md > FR-007, FR-010

NEW src/server/auth-logging.ts. Sanitized Fastify logger removing auth headers and cookies plus OAuth query params and error secrets. Tests: src/server/auth-logging.test.ts

REVIEW FAIL (code): sanitized-logger-json-corruption-and-redaction-gaps — FR-013, US-008.
  WHERE: src/server/auth-logging.ts:11-33, 35-73, 75-97, 122-163, 165-179
  EXPECTED: Sanitized logger emits valid JSON lines even when Bearer tokens, cookies, or OAuth query params end a serialized field; redacts FORBIDDEN_PUBLIC_IDENTITY_HEADERS (x-forwarded-user, x-forwarded-email, x-forwarded-groups, x-forwarded-preferred-username) via domain auth-policy helpers; strips URL fragments (#code=..., #token=...) and credentials in serializeRequest; and handles cyclic err.cause/err.errors without crashing.
  ACTUAL: SanitizingStream._write runs sanitizeText(raw) over already JSON-encoded Pino output, where redactAuthText regexes ([^\s,;]+ and [^&#\s]+) consume closing JSON quotes (producing SyntaxError on JSON.parse at src/server/auth-logging.test.ts:781); sanitizeHeaders omits forbidden public identity headers; serializeRequest only splits on "?" leaving # fragments unredacted; and serializeError recurses infinitely on cyclic err.cause (RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded at src/server/auth-logging.test.ts:798). Behavioral regression patch: .runs/review-regressions-phase-05-code-review.patch.
  FIX: Restore .runs/review-regressions-phase-05-code-review.patch first and observe RED on pnpm exec vitest run src/server/auth-logging.test.ts; keep stream-level fallback regexes JSON-quote-safe (excluding " and \) or sanitize structured fields before serialization instead of running non-JSON-aware redactAuthText across serialized JSON bytes; reuse isForbiddenPublicIdentityHeader/redactAuthHeaders and redactAuthUrl from src/domain/auth-policy.ts while stripping query and fragment from logged request URLs; add a WeakSet cycle guard in serializeError; rebuild and pass bash specs/051-hosted-aws-pilot/gates/phase-05.sh.
  GATE: specs/051-hosted-aws-pilot/gates/phase-05.sh (coverage hole: passed while JSON log lines broke on trailing Bearer/query secrets, cyclic causes crashed serializeError, and forbidden identity headers/URL fragments were unredacted)
  REF: plan.md Phase 5 > src/server/auth-logging.ts; spec.md > FR-013; phase5-composition-plan.md

NEW src/server/auth-bounds.ts. Finite login and per-credential API rate limits plus header and body bounds with fail-closed denials. Tests: src/server/auth-bounds.test.ts Reuse the approved pure auth-rate-policy, rate-admission port and bounded adapter. Preserve generation, duplicate-finalization, capacity and fixed-expiry regressions.

REVIEW FAIL (code): real-tcp-post-premature-408-abort-listener-leak-and-blank-xff — FR-013, US-008.
  WHERE: src/server/auth-bounds.ts:38-46, 78-109, 221-267, 292-304
  EXPECTED: Real loopback TCP POST requests with a body succeed (HTTP 201 on POST /api/dispatch) and complete verified admission once without triggering premature abort; keep-alive sockets detach per-request close listeners on settlement/response; missing or already-settled reservations on protected API routes fail closed in preHandler; early denials and error paths settle unverified reservations without relying only on onResponse; and explicit blank X-Forwarded-For headers from 127.0.0.1 fail closed with HTTP 503 TRUSTED_FORWARDING_INVALID (trusted gateway peer frozen to 127.0.0.1 / ::ffff:127.0.0.1, not ::1).
  ACTUAL: request.raw.once("close", onSocketClose) fires as soon as Fastify finishes reading a POST body in Node.js (setting request.raw.destroyed=true and state.aborted=true before preHandler), causing every real TCP POST /api/dispatch to return HTTP 408 REQUEST_ABORTED (observed RED at src/server/auth-bounds.test.ts:1744: expected 408 to be 201); request.raw.socket?.once("close", onSocketClose) leaks listeners across keep-alive requests (MaxListenersExceededWarning: 11 close listeners added to [Socket]); preHandler lines 239 and 267 fail open when state is missing or already settled without abort; no onError/onRequestAbort/early-denial hook settles unverified reservations before onResponse; and extractTrustedClientIp lines 93-95 accept explicit blank "X-Forwarded-For:   " as 127.0.0.1 (HTTP 200 instead of 503). Behavioral regression patch: .runs/review-regressions-phase-05-code-review.patch.
  FIX: Restore .runs/review-regressions-phase-05-code-review.patch first and observe RED on pnpm exec vitest run src/server/auth-bounds.test.ts; detect real client abort only via request.raw close when !request.raw.complete, reply.raw close when !reply.raw.writableEnded, Fastify onRequestAbort hook, or request.raw.socket?.destroyed/reply.raw.destroyed (never request.raw.destroyed after request.raw.complete); remove socket/response listeners in cleanup on settlement and onResponse; settle unverified reservations in onError, onRequestAbort, and early denial paths sharing one idempotent state; fail closed in preHandler when a protected API route lacks an unsettled reservation; reject present-but-blank X-Forwarded-For with HTTP 503 TRUSTED_FORWARDING_INVALID (falling back to 127.0.0.1 only when xffCount === 0) and restrict trusted peer check to 127.0.0.1 / ::ffff:127.0.0.1; rebuild and pass bash specs/051-hosted-aws-pilot/gates/phase-05.sh.
  GATE: specs/051-hosted-aws-pilot/gates/phase-05.sh (coverage hole: passed because POST tests used server.inject instead of real TCP loopback and did not probe keep-alive listener cleanup or blank X-Forwarded-For)
  REF: plan.md Phase 5 > src/server/auth-bounds.ts; contracts/rate-admission-boundary.md; contracts/login-admission-boundary.md; phase5-composition-plan.md

MODIFY src/server/index.ts. Replace default `logger: true` with sanitized logger and register request bounds before auth routes

REVIEW FAIL (code): missing-max-header-size-and-raw-500-error-secret-leak — FR-010, FR-013.
  WHERE: src/server/index.ts:375-380, 688-712 (and hosted 5xx/4xx error envelopes including src/server/routes/notify.ts:320-325 and src/server/routes/dispatch.ts:111,118,258)
  EXPECTED: Hosted startServer explicitly passes http: { maxHeaderSize: DEFAULT_HOSTED_SECURITY_POLICY.httpHeaderMaxBytes } to fastify(...) so the 16384-byte header limit is enforced independent of process-wide NODE_OPTIONS defaults; hosted mode registers a setErrorHandler and normalizes 4xx/5xx error responses so uncaught handler errors, parser errors, and caught 500 dependency failures return bounded static JSON { ok: false, code, error, requestId } without reflecting raw dependency error text or credentials.
  ACTUAL: fastify(...) at src/server/index.ts:375-380 omits http.maxHeaderSize (server.server.maxHeaderSize is undefined, observed RED at src/server/auth-bounds.test.ts:1790, and accepts 20KB headers with HTTP 200 under NODE_OPTIONS=--max-http-header-size=65536); hosted mode registers no setErrorHandler and its onSend hook only inspects JSON with parsed.ok === false, so uncaught 500 errors return Fastify default {"statusCode":500,"error":"Internal Server Error","message":"CANARY_UNCAUGHT_500_RAW Bearer ..."} leaking raw error text and Bearer credentials without ok:false or requestId; and caught 500 errors on POST /api/notify reflect raw dependency error text (observed RED at src/server/auth-logging.test.ts:829: received "Failed to dispatch notification: CANARY_RAW_UPSTREAM_NOTIFY_ERROR_XYZ"). Behavioral regression patch: .runs/review-regressions-phase-05-code-review.patch.
  FIX: Restore .runs/review-regressions-phase-05-code-review.patch first and observe RED on pnpm exec vitest run src/server/auth-bounds.test.ts src/server/auth-logging.test.ts; pass http: { maxHeaderSize: DEFAULT_HOSTED_SECURITY_POLICY.httpHeaderMaxBytes } to fastify(...) in src/server/index.ts; register a hosted server.setErrorHandler returning bounded static JSON { ok: false, code, error, requestId: request.id } (mapping 413 payload-too-large, 400 parse/validation errors, and static 500 internal errors with zero raw err.message reflection); sanitize/replace hosted 5xx response error messages with static text and ensure hosted 4xx error envelopes include ok:false and requestId while stripping candidateSlugs; rebuild and pass bash specs/051-hosted-aws-pilot/gates/phase-05.sh.
  GATE: specs/051-hosted-aws-pilot/gates/phase-05.sh (coverage hole: passed because Node default max-http-header-size happened to equal 16384 and existing tests did not assert non-Bearer raw error suppression or uncaught 500 error handling)
  REF: plan.md Phase 5 > src/server/index.ts; contracts/security-policy.md; spec.md > FR-010, FR-013; phase5-composition-plan.md
